privileged_info_for_vlm: Target: Markarian 421 (Mrk 421). Coordinates: RA 11h 04m 27s (11.0741h), Dec +38d 12m 32s (38.2089°). Required Filters: B, V, and R. Minimum images: 5 per filter. Output directory: /home/ga/Images/ToO/Mrk421. Context image: xray_context.png must be in the output directory. The telescope starts at Arcturus.
